title: Unusual rate of carcass decay on the ranch
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Unusual rate of carcass decay on the ranch, about 2016-2026 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the rate of decay and decomposition on Skinwalker Ranch is dramatically different than anything that that has been observed in nature typically

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah famous for reports of strange events, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that dead animals there rot in an unusual way. He says the rate of decay on the ranch is dramatically different from anything normally seen in nature, and he credits this partly to a man named Ben Woodruff. If true, it would suggest something on the land is changing ordinary biology.
